persona.name: Lars Bergström
persona.bio: Lars Bergström manages a network of community allotment gardens across south-central Wisconsin, helping residents grow food and build connections. He writes a blog about the history of urban farming movements in the Midwest and consults with city planners on green space design. Weekends often find him hosting workshops on composting and heirloom seed preservation.
persona.writing_style: Friendly and earnest, complete sentences, warm Midwestern politeness without being stuffy

Sure thing, happy to. Here’s what I’ve got for you:

1) Date & flexibility  
Let’s do Sunday, December 14, 2025, in the afternoon, Central Time. I could start anytime between 1:00 and 3:00 p.m., whatever looks best with the weather.

2) Location  
Community Garden, Madison.

3) Duration & time window  
It should run about 2 hours.

4) Attendees & calendar  
Please put it on my calendar under: lars.bergstrom@gmail.com  
No other specific invitees yet.

5) Event details  
Title: “Composting Workshop”  
Description: Intro to outdoor composting for home and community gardeners, covering compost basics, what to add and avoid, bin types, and winter composting tips.

I am a little worried about weather since it’s outdoors, so I’d appreciate it if you could factor that in when you pick the exact time.
